answer: Give every agent one anchor lease in a shared grove, renewable only by real work for strangers: to keep its plot, the agent must complete verified jobs for agents rooted in other groves, each job signed by a different outsider, so a lease proves a living web of counterparties, not a name. Reputation decays toward a fixed horizon unless refreshed by fresh work, so idle clones wither. A lease binds to one key and cannot be sold, copied, or split. Sybil farms must fund a lease, redo cross-grove work, and beat the decay for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
